candidates.phrase: all persons as created by Him, equal in all natural rights
candidates.rationale: Asserts humanity's existence as created by God, a narrower instance wholly within the Fountain of being floor.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe that the two great commandments which require us to love the Lord our God with all the heart, and our neighbors as ourselves, summarize the divine law as it is revealed in the Scriptures. They are the perfect measure and norm of human duty, both for the ordering and directing of families and nations, and all other social bodies, and for individual acts, by which we are required to acknowledge God as our only Supreme Ruler, and all persons as created by Him, equal in all natural rights. Therefore all persons should so order all their individual, social and political acts as to give to God entire and absolute obedience, and to assure to all the enjoyment of every natural right, as well as to promote the fulfillment of each in the possession and exercise of such rights.

Q-231-p1-BSR-MW-01-1.state_reason: The Article asserts God as maker of 'all things, both visible and invisible,' an unqualified universal creator-creature claim. This full affirmation stands in tension with the Restoration's coeternal-intelligence ontology, yielding the qualified agreement the family code already predicts; no divergence from family coding is warranted.
Q-231-p1-BSR-MW-01-1.source_note: Article I of the Articles of Religion (Book of Discipline) states that the one true God is 'the maker and preserver of all things, both visible and invisible.'
Q-231-p1-BSR-MW-01-1.scope_caveat: The Articles of Religion and the EUB Confession are constitutionally protected standards of the United Methodist Church. The Global Methodist Church, which separated in 2022, holds the same Articles; its standards are cited here from its 2022 Transitional Book of Doctrines and Discipline, the only edition published on the church's own domain, and the Articles are unchanged in the 2024 edition. The Wesleyan Church holds its own articles, which the registry lists separately.

survivors.locator: Article I — Of Faith in the Holy Trinity
survivors.phrase: the maker and preserver of all things, both visible and invisible
survivors.rationale: Asserts God as sole maker/preserver of all created reality, affirming creaturely existence as derived from God.
survivors.chunk_text: There is but one living and true God, everlasting, without body or parts, of infinite power, wisdom, and goodness; the maker and preserver of all things, both visible and invisible. And in unity of this Godhead there are three persons, of one substance, power, and eternity—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

survivors.phrase: who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible
survivors.rationale: Asserts God as Creator and source of all created things, affirming creaturely existence as derived from God.
survivors.chunk_text: We believe in the one true, holy and living God, Eternal Spirit, who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible. He is infinite in power, wisdom, justice, goodness and love, and rules with gracious regard for the well-being and salvation of men, to the glory of his name. We believe the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit, distinct but inseparable, eternally one in essence and power.

survivors.chunk_text: We believe the Father is the Source of all that exists, whether of matter or spirit. With the Son and the Holy Spirit, He made man, male and female, in His image. By intention He relates to people as Father, thereby forever declaring His goodwill toward them. In love, He both seeks and receives penitent sinners.
